input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Address 11 suggestion findings: linting, testing, and architectural improvements

- Bootstrap ESLint config with typescript-eslint and eslint-plugin-import-x
  for cycle detection and engine barrel enforcement
- Add Vitest with 17 tests covering posKey format and simulateTraversal
  outcomes (goal, no-path, edge, obstacle, blocked, curve navigation)
- Fix persistence.loadSave shallow merge: deep-merge settings sub-object
  to be forward-compatible with new settings fields
- Move getBiomeCanvasColors from engine barrel to board-utils (rendering
  concern, not domain concern) preserving engine's zero-coupling guarantee
- Extract SVG_WIDTH, SVG_HEIGHT, ARC_CENTER_Y_RATIO as shared constants
  between useRainbowEasterEgg and worlds.tsx to make coupling explicit
- Add unlockedLevels field to SaveData so easter egg grants access without
  fabricating completion scores in completedLevels
- Guard useGameSession.nextLevel against advancing into locked worlds
- Eliminate two-phase init flash in worlds.tsx by initialising from
  loadSave() directly with SSR guard
- Consolidate TILE_DEFS/TILES into canonical TILE_TYPE_DEFS in engine
- Replace dual-source level ID in play.tsx with single useParams() source
  of truth, dropping local useState

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

input.resolutionDetail: Implemented all 11 suggestion findings: ESLint config, Vitest + 17 tests, deep-merge settings in persistence, moved getBiomeCanvasColors to board-utils, extracted SVG constants, added unlockedLevels to SaveData, guarded nextLevel against locked worlds, eliminated SSR init flash, consolidated tile type registries, and unified play.tsx to single useParams() source of truth.

input.detail:
Commit a71d4eb addresses all 11 suggestion findings:

1. ESLint: Created eslint.config.ts with @eslint/js, typescript-eslint, eslint-plugin-import-x. Rules: no-cycle, no-restricted-paths (engine barrel enforcement), no-duplicates.
2. Vitest: Added vitest + vitest.config.ts. Created 17 tests in traversal.test.ts and utils.test.ts covering posKey format and all simulateTraversal outcomes.
3. Persistence zone: Already tracked in game-session-persistence zone — acknowledged.
4. Deep merge: loadSave() now field-level defaults settings sub-object.
5. getBiomeCanvasColors: Moved from engine barrel to board-utils.ts (rendering concern).
6. SVG constants: Exported SVG_WIDTH, SVG_HEIGHT, ARC_CENTER_Y_RATIO from useRainbowEasterEgg, imported in worlds.tsx.
7. nextLevel guard: useMemo checks save.unlockedWorlds before offering next level in a different world.
8. unlockedLevels: Added SaveData.unlockedLevels[]; easter egg populates this instead of fabricating completedLevels entries. isLevelUnlocked checks both.
9. SSR init flash: worlds.tsx initialises from loadSave() with typeof window guard, eliminating useEffect two-phase render.
10. TILE_TYPE_DEFS: Canonical registry in engine/types.ts, used by both TileInventory and MobileInventory.
11. play.tsx: Removed local useState for levelId, derive solely from useParams(). URL navigation triggers remount via key={levelId}.

All 17 tests pass, typecheck clean, build succeeds.
